description: Rank-tracking metrics broken down per keyword cluster for a project over a date window: one row per cluster with its positions, share of voice and sentiment. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "which keyword clusters are strongest or weakest" or "how does my niche compare to my generic queries".

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

name: get_cluster_breakdown
title: Rank tracking by keyword cluster
